recentItems.title: Murder in Galicia | Official Trailer | Netflix
recentItems.description:
Pazos is a small, seemingly peaceful town in Galicia, where a series of home burglaries is beginning to cause concern among the residents. Amid this uncertainty, Irene is the victim of a violent attack in her own home. While she fights for her life in the hospital, Elías, a sergeant in the Civil Guard, follows a lead that points directly to Aniceto, Irene’s husband, as the prime suspect. However, he can’t get anyone to believe him, and as a result, Aniceto remains at large, putting Irene’s life in danger as she is confined 24 hours a day with her alleged killer.

Tristán Ulloa and Miguel Borines star in this true-crime drama, alongside Carlos Blanco, Fer Fraga, Verónica Sánchez, Fernando Guillén Cuervo, Nacho Fresneda, and Tito Asorey. Ramon Campos serves as executive producer, with Carlos Sedes directing.

recentItems.title: Taken: Natalee Holloway | Official Trailer | Netflix
recentItems.description:
On May 30, 2005, 18-year-old Natalee Holloway vanished on a high school graduation trip to Aruba — and never came home. What followed was years of unanswered questions, a missing teenager, and a mother's relentless fight for the truth. Now, over 20 years later, Natalee's mother, Beth, is ready to tell the complete story. With exclusive, unprecedented access to Beth and those who were with Natalee when she vanished, this three-part documentary series from Story Syndicate (Maternal Instinct, Titan: The Oceangate Disaster) and directors Dani Sloane and Matthew Galkin is the definitive account of a case that gripped a nation and never let go. It's a story of a mother who refused to stop searching, an investigation that spanned continents, and a daughter whose memory endures. This is Natalee's story, told at last in full.

recentItems.title: In Waves | Official Trailer | Netflix
recentItems.description:
AJ (voiced by Will Sharpe), a reserved high school student in Los Angeles, spends his days drawing and skateboarding with his friends. Kristen (voiced by Stephanie Hsu), an energetic surfer, finds joy and freedom in the ocean. When they meet, curiosity evolves into deep love: Kristen teaches AJ to surf and shares its historical connection to Hawaiian culture. As their relationship grows closer, AJ is inspired to preserve their connection by drawing their story.

An animated true story set against the sun-soaked surf culture of Southern California, IN WAVES explores the joy of finding your soulmate, the courage it takes to live life to the fullest, and the enduring power of love to shape who we become and what we leave behind.

Watch IN WAVES – in select theaters November 27 and on Netflix December 11.
